About StackedByBayo

StackedByBayo makes technology easier to understand through news, guides, and reviews.

Meet the founder

I’m Omobayonle Ogundele, an IT Help Desk professional based in Lagos, Nigeria.

My work in IT support

I work in IT Help Desk, where I help people troubleshoot everyday technology problems. I’m interested in the fundamentals behind those problems, from hardware and operating systems to networking.

What I’m learning

I’m learning cloud computing and DevOps through hands-on projects. I share what I build, what goes wrong, and what I learn from fixing it.

Why I write

I want to make technical ideas easier to understand and give beginners a practical place to start.
